title: αtmos | A browser app for composing ambient soundscapes
author: RavenJe94
selftext:
I built this simple app for my wife, who writes. You layer rain, wind, distant voices and bells, set each sound's volume, place it left or right, and drop it "behind a window" or "in a cathedral" then let it play. As I've said: simple.

No account, no upload, no server. It writes straight into a folder you pick, so your work is yours: ordinary files you can copy or back up.

That also means Chrome or Edge on a desktop, since they're the only ones that allow it.

Vibecoded with Claude, (opus 5.5 for who is interested) start to finish, I'm not a good programmer, and a busy husband. The design went through two rounds of review before I shipped it, and I'd rather hear what's wrong with it than not.

Free, MIT, no tracking of any kind.

Enjoy?

[https://ernestocampese.github.io/atmos/](https://ernestocampese.github.io/atmos/)
